description: This file contains class definitions and declarations for managing an H.264 Decoded Picture Buffer (DPB) and H264Picture objects used in H.264 decoders, including methods for storing, retrieving, and managing reference pictures.

classes.name: H264Picture
classes.description: Represents an H.264 picture (frame or field) with associated properties and methods for type casting.

classes.name: H264DPB
classes.description: Implements the Decoded Picture Buffer for storing and managing H.264 decoded pictures, including reference picture management.

methods.name: set_max_num_pics
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of pictures the DPB can hold.

methods.name: DeleteUnused
methods.description: Removes unused (not reference and already outputted) pictures from the DPB.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a specific picture from the DPB.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all pictures from the DPB.

methods.name: StorePic
methods.description: Stores a picture in the DPB, taking ownership of its resources.

methods.name: CountRefPics
methods.description: Returns the number of reference pictures in the DPB.

methods.name: MarkAllUnusedForRef
methods.description: Marks all pictures in the DPB as unused for reference.

methods.name: GetShortRefPicByPicNum
methods.description: Retrieves a short-term reference picture by its pic_num.

methods.name: GetLongRefPicByLongTermPicNum
methods.description: Retrieves a long-term reference picture by its long_term_pic_num.

methods.name: GetLongRefPicByLongTermIdx
methods.description: Retrieves a long-term reference picture by its long term reference index.

methods.name: GetLowestFrameNumWrapShortRefPic
methods.description: Returns the short-term reference picture with the lowest frame_num.

methods.name: GetNotOutputtedPicsAppending
methods.description: Appends all pictures not yet outputted to the provided vector, sorted by pic_order_cnt.

methods.name: GetShortTermRefPicsAppending
methods.description: Appends all short-term reference pictures to the provided vector.

methods.name: GetLongTermRefPicsAppending
methods.description: Appends all long-term reference pictures to the provided vector.
